title: Pure Duston
summary: Pure Duston swarm and field-clogging strategy centered on House Duston, White Duston, and the colored Duston fiends. By crashing House Duston into an opponent's monster via Creature Swap or battle, the deck floods both players' Monster Zones with useless colored Dustons that cannot be tributed or used as Extra Deck material, fueling an astronomical ATK OTK with Starduston or Goblin King.

summary.title: Starters
points: House Duston is the prime engine detonator: when destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect, it Special Summons any number of Dustons from hand and Deck to both fields in equal numbers.
One for One sends a monster from hand to GY to Special Summon House Duston directly from your Deck.
Where Arf Thou? searches House Duston, Starduston, or Goblin King from your Deck while you control any Level 1 monster.
Unexpected Dai Special Summons White Duston directly from your Deck while you control no monsters, enabling Where Arf Thou? without using your Normal Summon.
Creature Swap gives your Attack Position 0 ATK House Duston to the opponent in exchange for their monster, letting you crash into it and trigger its swarm immediately on your turn.

summary.title: Opening: Unexpected Dai + House Duston + Creature Swap
steps: Activate Unexpected Dai with an empty field to Special Summon White Duston from your Deck.
Normal Summon House Duston in Attack Position.
Activate Creature Swap, giving your 0 ATK House Duston to your opponent and taking their monster.
Declare an attack with your stolen monster into House Duston, destroying House Duston by battle.
Trigger House Duston to summon up to 4 colored Dustons (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) to your opponent's field and 4 Dustons to your field in Defense Position.
Send your Dustons to the GY to Special Summon Starduston with up to 8000+ ATK, or summon Goblin King to attack over the 0 DEF Dustons for game.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Starduston Special Summons itself from hand or GY by sending any number of Dustons you control to the GY; it gains 1000 ATK/DEF for each Duston on the field, prevents the opponent from flipping monsters face-up or Special Summoning, and prevents their Set Spells/Traps from activating.

Goblin King cannot be targeted for attacks while another Fiend is on the field, and gains 1000 ATK/DEF for every other Fiend monster on both sides of the field, reaching up to 9000 ATK after House Duston resolves.

The colored Dustons (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) completely clog the opponent's Monster Zones: they cannot be Tributed, cannot be used as Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Material, and trigger detrimental burn, mill, or banish effects when destroyed.
White Duston is a proud Normal Monster that lacks the tribute/material restrictions of the colored Dustons, allowing you to freely Link Summon Linkuriboh or Relinquished Anima.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Magicalized Duston Mop equips to any monster to prevent it from being Tributed or used as Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Material, and searches any Duston monster from Deck to hand when destroyed by an opponent's card.
Duston Roller prevents a monster on the field from being Tributed or used for Extra Deck summons this turn, and searches a Duston monster if destroyed while Set.
Linkuriboh and Relinquished Anima provide essential Link-1 outlets to clear Duston bodies from your own field while absorbing opposing threats.

allow.One for One: Discards 1 monster to Special Summon House Duston or White Duston directly from the Deck.
allow.Where Arf Thou?: Searches any Level 1 Duston monster (House Duston, Starduston, or Goblin King) from the Deck while you control a Level 1 monster.
allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons White Duston directly from the Deck while you control no monsters.
allow.Creature Swap: Gives your Attack Position 0 ATK House Duston to the opponent in exchange for their monster, letting you attack into your own House Duston to immediately trigger its 8-Duston board flood!
allow.Linkuriboh: Converts your own Duston monsters into Link Material so you are not locked by your own Dustons.
allow.Relinquished Anima: Link-1 that uses a Level 1 Duston on your field to absorb an opponent's monster.

main: House Duston

Core starter: when destroyed by battle with an opponent's attacking monster or by an opponent's card effect, Special Summons any number of 'Duston' monsters from your hand and/or Deck to BOTH players' fields (an equal number to each side).
Starduston

Signature boss: Special Summons itself by sending any number of Duston monsters you control to the GY (gains 1000 ATK/DEF per Duston on the field!), and locks the opponent out of activating Set Spells/Traps AND Special Summoning or flipping monsters!
White Duston
The proudest of the Dustons! Level 1 LIGHT Fiend Normal Monster summoned by House Duston and Unexpected Dai that CAN be used by you for Synchro/Xyz/Link plays.
Red Duston
Level 1 FIRE Fiend Duston given to the opponent by House Duston; cannot be Tributed or used as Fusion/Synchro/Xyz Material, and inflicts 500 burn damage to its controller when destroyed.
Yellow Duston
Level 1 EARTH Fiend Duston that cannot be Tributed or used as Fusion/Synchro/Xyz Material, and shuffles 1 monster from its controller's GY into the Deck when destroyed.
Green Duston
Level 1 WIND Fiend Duston that cannot be Tributed or used as Fusion/Synchro/Xyz Material, and bounces 1 Spell/Trap its controller controls when destroyed.
Blue Duston
Level 1 WATER Fiend Duston that cannot be Tributed or used as Fusion/Synchro/Xyz Material, and banishes 1 random card from its controller's hand face-down when destroyed.
Goblin King

Honorary Duston finisher (depicted in Duston Roller) that cannot be attacked while another Fiend is on the field and gains 1000 ATK/DEF for every other Fiend on BOTH fields (up to 9000 ATK after House Duston resolves!).
Magicalized Duston Mop
Equip Spell that prevents the equipped monster from being Tributed or used as Fusion/Synchro/Xyz Material, and searches any Duston monster when destroyed by an opponent's card.
Duston Roller
Normal Trap that prevents 1 monster on the field from being Tributed or used as Fusion/Synchro/Xyz Material this turn, and searches any Duston monster if destroyed Set.
Where Arf Thou?
Searches Starduston, Goblin King, or House Duston from the Deck.
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons White Duston from the Deck to enable Where Arf Thou? and Creature Swap.
Creature Swap
Swaps White Duston or Attack Position House Duston with an opponent's monster so you can crash into House Duston and trigger it on your own turn.
One for One
Special Summons House Duston directly from the Deck.
extra: Link-1 that tributes a Level 1 Duston on your field to clear your zones or drop an attacking monster's ATK to 0.
Link-1 that uses a Level 1 Duston on your field to equip an opponent's monster in front of the Extra Monster Zone.
